basis: Mesenchymal sarcoma arising predominantly in bone or soft tissue; no additional organ involvement established.
Name suggests Gaucher-associated storage disease with ichthyosis/restrictive dermopathy; additional organ injury and frequencies are unspecified.
Hereditary demyelinating peripheral neuropathy; muscle weakness reflects nerve dysfunction.
Persistent neurodevelopmental impairment of academic information processing and learning.
Benign blood vessel tumor arising in the subglottic airway.
Destructive dental disease classified under dental caries; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Benign brown adipose tissue tumor, usually located in subcutaneous soft tissue; rare alternative sites do not define the umbrella.
Defined metabolic liver disease with neurodegeneration; ichthyosis/dermatitis 4/6. Dental defects ~50% and hearing loss 2/6 omitted by cap; cortical blindness is neurologic.
Bacterial infection umbrella with variable anatomical sites; no additional organ is consistently affected across the group.
Dyserythropoietic anemia with a glycosylation defect. Gallstones are separately coded; iron loading alone does not establish hepatic functional injury in at least 30%.
GJA8-associated cataract directly affects the ocular lens.
Inherited dysmyelination establishes neurologic disease; jaundice alone does not establish hepatic injury, and its mechanism is unspecified.
Nonsyndromic postaxial polydactyly is a structural skeletal anomaly of the hands and feet.
Lysosomal storage with neurodegeneration; skeletal abnormalities 80-99% and structural cardiac abnormalities 30-79%. Skin findings omitted by cap; organomegaly alone is insufficient.
ELF4 autoinflammation with oral ulcers 4/4 and gastritis 2/2; arthritis 1/1 assessed, with uncertain prevalence. Iron deficiency anemia is secondary; rash lacks established damage.
Inherited LDL metabolism disorder; atherosclerosis is a separate disease. Tendon xanthomas alone do not establish functional locomotor injury.
Thymic epithelial tumor; thymus has no anatomical axis here. Thymoma itself is neither lymphoma nor an immune mechanism; associated autoimmune diseases are separate.
Congenital cholesteatoma directly occupies and can damage the middle ear.
Primary skeletal myopathy with progressive muscle weakness and atrophy; cardiomyopathy occurs in only 5-29%.
Intestinal impaction causes mechanical intestinal obstruction.
Hereditary selective loss of smell for isovaleric acid; olfactory function belongs to the neurologic axis.
Usually phenotypically silent, with no intrinsic organ injury; recessive diseases unmasked by homozygosity are separate diagnoses.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; developmental delay 4/8 and intellectual disability 3/8. Hearing loss 2/8 is below 30%; absent acoustic reflex alone is insufficient.
ID, keratoconus and skeletal/joint anomalies define syndrome; obesity/hyperlipidemia 80-99%. Hearing loss and cleft palate 30-79% omitted by cap.
Acute myeloid leukemia defined by its cytogenetic translocation; malignant myeloid cells affect blood and marrow.
